headline: Light.
Leaf.
Season.
heroNote: A year of close looking in the gardens at RHS Wisley, where I work the beds on Battleston Hill.
aboutBody: I'm a horticulturalist at RHS Wisley, responsible for Battleston Hill. The photographs come out of the same looking the job asks for — knowing when a flower is three days from its best, or when the low light finally reaches something that spends most of the day in shade.
Shot on a Sony a7CR with a 24–105mm. Plant names follow the collection records; corrections are always welcome.
